summary: This first Viking lecture is already-linked support for Borderland Engine, Education, and the atlas formation-capacity relation, while holding a reusable Viking selfhood / co-optation seed for later comparison with the follow-up Viking memory source and Protestant cultural-residue material.

existing_lens_links.rationale: The public Borderland page already uses this Viking lecture in the oceanic-current anchor: a margin touched by empire can be swallowed, destroyed, or become empire.

existing_lens_links.rationale: The episode read already links the military-form / feudal-hierarchy diagnosis to the public Borderland anchor. This is a strong existing routing point, not a reason for new Strategy prose.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: keep this source as one of Borderland Engine's strong Viking anchors. It gives the page energy, openness, cooperative competition, opportunism, river/sea mobility, hierarchy-lock, and the full arc from marginal pressure to aristocratic absorption.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Borderland owns this source because Jiang explicitly turns the Vikings into a case of the oceanic-current model: isolated margin, contact with empire, energy transfer, tactical opportunism, military-form mismatch, and eventual absorption.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: the Viking-school provocation supports Education's contrast between practical formation and controlled elite schooling. Do not append another Education example now because the existing anchor already carries the source.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Education owns formation when the active mechanism is what a school or training environment does to the soul. Here the broader lecture is not an education page; Viking schooling is one diagnostic within Borderland's energy/openness model.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold the Viking funeral preview as boundary pressure only. The follow-up Viking Memory Machine source already supplies the public Sacred Machines treatment of funeral as staged memory technology; this first lecture mainly previews the funeral and keeps the main pressure on Borderland.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Sacred Machines owns public action-forms that make unseen relation participable. This lecture gestures toward that machine, but it explicitly defers the detailed funeral worldview to the next class.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold the nation-state / individual-rights contrast as boundary pressure only. Jiang uses the modern nation-state as the foil for premodern community-formed personhood; the source is not primarily about nation as sacred collective machine.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Nation owns modern collective-body and state-protection machinery. This source uses nation-state ideology as a contrast to Viking communal identity, so Nation should not absorb the Viking lecture now.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold military form and feudal hierarchy as Strategy-adjacent pressure only. Strategy owns whether a war form is materially executable; Borderland owns why a marginal war form exploits the center's locked hierarchy.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: This should not become another Strategy append because the active mechanism is a borderland exploiting center hierarchy, not a general theory of material war-testing.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold the aristocratic absorption and Christian conversion material as legitimacy pressure only: bandit wealth becomes safe when converted into nobility, intermarriage, elite conversion, and military service.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Legitimacy Fiction owns recognized status forms, but this source's co-optation arc is still the endpoint of Borderland pressure. Use it for later comparison only if a broader force-to-legitimacy review accumulates enough sources.

new_lens_seeds.title: Communal Story Selfhood
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: In a community-centered culture, the individual becomes real by adding deeds to the shared story that the group retells; banishment is therefore social death because the person loses the memory-world that makes the self alive.
new_lens_seeds.reuse_potential: This seed can later compare Viking selfhood, Greek polis excellence, Roman piety, Homeric memory, national personhood, and modern individual-rights ideology, but this first Viking lecture should not create a standalone page because it explicitly previews the follow-up worldview class.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Hold this until compared with predictive-history-tymnsa83nhy / Viking Memory Machine and Poetry / Sacred Machines memory pages. It should not become a generic individualism page.

new_lens_seeds.title: Institutional Arbitrage Becomes Legitimacy
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A marginal force can exploit a center's sacred or military weaknesses, accumulate wealth, then protect that wealth by converting into recognized elite status, religion, intermarriage, and service to the same center.
new_lens_seeds.reuse_potential: The seed may later compare Vikings, Normans, HRE recognition, Byzantine diplomacy, borderland conquerors, and modern capital/power laundering, but this source alone remains Borderland evidence rather than a public Legitimacy Fiction child.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Hold as a comparison seed. Public prose would blur Borderland, Legitimacy Fiction, Bureaucracy, and Religion unless more dated sources prove a narrower reusable mechanism.

chronology_notes.note: Dated 2025-03-04, this is the first of two Viking classes. It gives the historical overview, borderland model, and initial community/selfhood preview; predictive-history-tymnsa83nhy / The Viking Memory Machine should remain the follow-up worldview and memory-machine layer.

This source supplies a dated Viking formulation of the borderland oceanic-current model: the margin is touched by empire, receives energy, develops cooperative competition, exploits center weakness, and is eventually absorbed or becomes empire.

The source includes a conversion-order claim: elite conversion comes first and followers convert afterward. Hold this as background comparison for operator-selection / top-down conversion pressure, not as public Religion prose from this source alone.

next_actions.action: Do not create standalone The Viking Legacy, Fifth Pillar Of The West, Vikings, Viking School, Viking Funeral, Longship, Norman Assimilation, Viking Selfhood, or Community Story Selfhood pages from this source alone.

If the Viking cluster gets public synthesis, compare this overview with predictive-history-tymnsa83nhy / The Viking Memory Machine, the Protestant cultural-residue material in predictive-history-tcxloijz8v0, and existing Borderland / Sacred Machines / Poetry pages before adding ordinary prose.
